query: SELECT cp.status as planilha_status, ca.status as action_status, COUNT(*) as qtd FROM cobranca_planilha cp LEFT JOIN collection_actions ca ON cp.ar_id = ca.receivableId WHERE cp.ar_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cp.status, ca.status ORDER BY qtd DESC LIMIT 20;
